title: RISA: Response Inspection and Selective Actions for Refusal Calibration

summary.claim: RISA checks the initial response first and corrects refusal errors only when needed, improving refusal reliability without changing the base model and keeping most of its usefulness.
summary.condition: Rule-based scores combined with a calibrated linear probe on the prompt's final-layer hidden state; thresholds calibrated per base model.
summary.gap: (Inferred) The probe and thresholds must be recalibrated for each model, and the cost of probe errors is not given in the abstract.
